_comment: PICO Connect (prism driver) tracker binding template.
Use this when streaming the PICO 4 Ultra (or PICO 4 Pro) into SteamVR via
PICO Connect with PICO Motion Trackers attached -- i.e. the 'PICO Connect
-> SteamVR -> PC -> Isaac Lab' pipeline introduced in 9.37.  Pass
--vr_runtime pico_connect
to ust_ws.ust_hm_glove.scripts.run_teleop and the device picks this file
automatically (overriding the default tracker_binding.json which is
calibrated for Virtual Desktop body segments).
Generating real serials:
1. Launch PICO Connect on PC, put the headset on, pair every Motion
Tracker (PMT-#) to the headset and confirm 'PICO Connect Streaming
Service' is running (Task Manager).  SteamVR > Manage Add-Ons:
prism                            ON   (PICO Connect)
Virtual Desktop Streamer (Quest) OFF  (avoid driver conflict)
udcap                            ON   (only if using UDCAP gloves)
2. Run:
python -X utf8 -m ust_ws.ust_hm_glove.scripts.enumerate_trackers \
--out ust_ws/ust_hm_glove/config/tracker_binding_pico_connect.json
The script auto-detects PICO trackers from their manufacturer/model
strings and emits a populated 'trackers' map -- this template is
overwritten in place.
3. Verify each PICO Motion Tracker maps to the body part you actually
wear it on (waist / left_forearm / right_forearm / left_ankle /
right_ankle).  PICO ships trackers without a fixed role assignment;
the user MUST inspect their physical mounting before saving.
Serial conventions observed in PICO Connect 5.14+:
* PICO Motion Tracker (PMT)        : serial like 'PMT_<14-hex-char>'
* PICO Body Tracker  (legacy SDK)  : serial like 'PICOBT_<...>'
* Manufacturer string              : 'PICO' or 'Pico Immersive Pte. Ltd.'
* Model strings                    : 'PICO Motion Tracker', 'PMT-1.0'
If you only have a single hips tracker, leave the unused entries empty
({}) and they will be skipped by SteamVRSampler.
steamvr_role values (informational; SteamVRSampler uses 'role' for binding):
TrackerRole_Waist        - hips/waist tracker
TrackerRole_LeftElbow    - left forearm/elbow
TrackerRole_RightElbow   - right forearm/elbow
TrackerRole_LeftFoot     - left ankle/foot
TrackerRole_RightFoot    - right ankle/foot
TrackerRole_Chest        - chest tracker (rare)
